title: Agents
intro: The AI agents the app can open, what each one can do and which one each action uses.
onlyCompatible: Compatible, but the app has no button for it: open it yourself and ask it for what you need.
notLaunchable: Configured, but the app can't open it with a command: use it yourself from its terminal.
modelHelp: Free text: it isn't checked online.
noModelChoice: This agent can't pick the model when it's launched.
subagentsInherit: The tasks it delegates (e.g. extracting a job) use this same model.
byActionIntro: Change the agent and model for a specific action. “Effective” is what the next button will use.

blocked.not_launchable: The app can't open this agent.
blocked.no_headless: This agent can't run in the background.
blocked.capability: This agent lacks a capability the action needs.
blocked.untrusted: Level C with untrusted content: terminal only.
blocked.model: The chosen model isn't valid for this agent.

warning: Check before launching it: the agents guide explains why.

local.title: Local models (Ollama)
local.contextLow: {{model}}: {{tokens}}-token context. Agents need at least {{min}}: set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH={{min}} and restart Ollama.
local.smallModel: {{model}} is chosen for “{{action}}”: models of about 8B or less tend to fail the CV schemas.
local.noModels: Ollama is running but has no models: download one with “ollama pull”.
local.guide: How to set it up: see the free models guide. The app only reads which models exist; it never asks them anything.

tiers.title: Spending tiers
tiers.intro: Agent and model for the main actions, in three tiers. Fill them in once and apply one with a click: it changes your “By action” table and can be undone.

economy.label: Economy
economy.help: Closed actions (process, assess, replies) with a local model; the CV with your most capable agent.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.help: Closed actions with the fast model of your most capable agent; the CV with its usual model.

max.label: Maximum
max.help: Everything with your most capable agent and its usual model.

notes.no_local_agent: No agent with local models is installed: it uses your agent's fast model.
notes.needs_local_model: Set the local model under “Edit” (e.g. your Ollama one) to be able to apply it.
notes.no_agent: No agent can be opened from the app.

fineTune: Choose agent and model per action

getAgent.title: You need an AI agent
getAgent.why: CandidatAI keeps your search in order, but it doesn't read jobs or write CVs on its own: an AI agent does that, a program you install on your computer that uses your subscription. It isn't the Claude chat app or claude.ai: it's a separate program, like Claude Code, included in Claude Pro.
getAgent.step1: Pick one. If you're not sure, Claude Code: it's the most tested with CandidatAI and comes with Claude Pro. If you already pay for ChatGPT Plus, Codex.

configure.title: Versions, models and which one opens what
configure.body: Check what you have installed, choose the models and decide which agent each action uses.
